args.Description: "Style font options to preview the font directly in the dropdown"
args.Instruction: "Add inline styles to the select and option elements to preview the font family."
args.ReplacementContent:
"                                        <select
                                            value={activeField.fontFamily}
                                            onChange={e => updateField(activeFieldIndex, 'fontFamily', e.target.value)}
                                            style={{ fontFamily: activeField.fontFamily }}
                                            className="w-full bg-black border-2 border-zinc-700 p-2 text-white rounded-lg focus:border-brand-yellow focus:outline-none text-sm"
                                        >
                                            <optgroup label="System Fonts">
                                                {DEFAULT_FONTS.filter(f => ['Arial', 'Times New Roman', 'Georgia', 'Courier New', 'Verdana', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Impact', 'Comic Sans MS'].includes(f)).map(f => (
                                                    <option key={f} value={f} style={{ fontFamily: f }}>{f}</option>
                                                ))}
                                            </optgroup>
                                            <optgroup label="Google Fonts">
                                                {DEFAULT_FONTS.filter(f => !['Arial', 'Times New Roman', 'Georgia', 'Courier New', 'Verdana', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Impact', 'Comic Sans MS'].includes(f)).map(f => (
                                                    <option key={f} value={f} style={{ fontFamily: f }}>{f}</option>
                                                ))}
                                            </optgroup>
                                            {customFonts.length > 0 && (
                                                <optgroup label="Custom Fonts">
                                                    {customFonts.map(f => (
                                                        <option key={f.name} value={f.name} style={{ fontFamily: f.name }}>{f.name}</option>
                                                    ))}

args.Description: "Add a convenient save button to the email template section"
args.Instruction: "Replace the confusing 'Remember to Save' warning with an actual 'Save Configuration' button."
args.ReplacementContent:
"                                        <button
                                            onClick={handleSave}
                                            disabled={saving || !templateUrl}
                                            className="w-full bg-brand-yellow text-black font-black text-lg py-4 rounded-xl border-4 border-white hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_white] transition-all disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center gap-3 uppercase tracking-wider mt-4"
                                        >
                                            {saving ? (
                                                <><Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> Saving...</>
                                            ) : (
                                                <><Save className="w-5 h-5" /> Save Configuration</>
                                            )}
                                        </button>"
